narrative.intro: Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C obligated $2.3B in FY2026 to date, across 7 awards. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C received an average award size of $329M and obligations are up 1171.7% year over year. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C has two clear agency buyers: the Department of Homeland Security accounted for $2.2B of obligations and the Department of Defense accounted for $99M in FY2026 to date. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C shows a sharp change from prior years, with obligations of $259M in FY21, $168M in FY22, $195M in FY23, $54.5M in FY24, and $181M in FY25. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date activity. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C concentration with DHS is the dominant feature of FY2026 to date obligations, while DoD represents a much smaller share. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C average award size and the large single-agency concentration are key details contractors and partners should note when evaluating the company’s federal footprint.
